result:
I’d make fear more honest.

Not erase it—fear is often a rational warning—but make it visible, so people couldn’t hide behind dehumanizing others, turning neighbors into enemies, or feeding old grudges with new violence.

If people could recognize their own fear clearly, it would lose a lot of its power to command cruelty. And if fear stops being a weapon, many of the worst things the world does to itself stop before they begin.
